evidence.t: Shallow Lake, 103.2 ha, 40 m from the road.
About 11 wetlands within 2 km (estimate): ducks move between them.
Beside Tutshi River: backwater or oxbow (estimate).
Elevation 860 m: under 900 m, open water later in fall.

flags.t: MU (Management Unit) 6-27, Region 6 Skeena. Near the MU line: check the MU map.
Klondike Hwy 40 m NW: no hunting or shooting on or across the road allowance of a numbered highway or 2 lane public road, 15 m (16 yd) each side of the centre line (synopsis page 10, 99%).

seasonRows.notes: District 6. Within the 8 a day: 4 northern pintails, 4 canvasbacks, 2 Barrow's or common goldeneyes together, 2 harlequins. Possession 24: 12, 12, 6, 6.

plan: Drive: from Atlin, about 97 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 59.72739, -134.99589, pull off on Klondike Hwy (paved road). Map links below.
Walk: 40 m SE, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 0 m, about 5 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: ducks, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-27, Region 6. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-09-03, closures 2026-10-16.
R6T-duck-drive-0003.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 6-27: about 782 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.12 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: close to pavement, a town or a rec site. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
